description: Probe a server's TLS configuration: which protocol versions (TLS 1.0 → 1.3) it accepts, the cipher negotiated for each, and a downgrade-risk verdict. Legacy protocols still accepting connections are flagged — weak TLS is a compliance finding agents get asked about. Use this when an agent needs to which TLS protocols and ciphers a server accepts. x402 price $0.02/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: security_tls_versions
title: TLS Version Support Scan
